observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: A large indoor hall with a wooden dance floor, audience seated on both sides, and a DJ booth in the background.
observation.formation_and_space: The dancer moves across the center of the floor, occasionally traveling in a straight line or small circles.
observation.posture: Upright torso, shoulders held back and down, knees slightly bent, weight centered over the balls of the feet.
observation.footwork: Rapid, percussive steps including toe taps, heel clicks, and shuffles, performed on the balls of the feet in time with the music.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms are held straight and stiff at the sides, hands slightly clenched, with minimal movement.
observation.hips_and_torso: Torso remains largely still and upright, with no hip isolations.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Includes high jumps, leaps, and quick, tight turns.
observation.costume_and_props: A traditional Irish dance dress with a red, sequined bodice and a white, layered skirt, worn with black tights and hard-soled dance shoes.
observation.cannot_infer: The speed of the footwork makes it difficult to distinguish individual steps, and the lighting effects obscure some details of the lower body.

signature_moments.what: Rapid, rhythmic footwork while maintaining a perfectly still upper body.
A high, controlled jump with legs tucked.
A final, energetic jump followed by a bow.
